snacs_adaptation_notes.txt:
SNACS v2.6 adaptation notes from authorized guidelines and purchased reviews examples. Output each target as [scene role, lexical function], with p. prefixes. Scene role reflects the relation in context; function reflects what the marker conventionally expresses. Check each target's actual governor and object.

Genitives and possessives: possessive pronouns commonly have p.Gestalt function, while their scene role depends on the relation to the head noun. 'my fusions' (patient undergoing surgery) = p.Theme/p.Gestalt; 'my back' (body part) = p.Whole/p.Gestalt; 'my experience' = p.Experiencer/p.Gestalt; 'their product' (produced by them) = p.Originator/p.Gestalt. Established interpersonal or professional ties take p.SocialRel/p.Gestalt: 'your child,' 'my waiter,' 'his staff.' A loose association such as 'their hours' can be p.Gestalt/p.Gestalt. Do not infer p.Possessor solely from possessive form; reserve it for an animate party's alienable property. S-genitive function is p.Gestalt or p.Possessor, never p.Whole.

Quantity and part-whole: 'a limited amount of time' = p.QuantityItem/p.Gestalt for of with a measure noun plus modifier. 'a whole day of work' = p.QuantityItem/p.QuantityItem. 'worst of all' = p.Whole/p.Whole: all is the comparison set from which the worst member is selected. Distinguish measured item, quantity, and selected whole by construction.

Identity and comparison: 'a gem of a restaurant' = p.Identity/p.Identity; guideline explicitly treats this exclamative indefinite-NP pattern as Identity. 'identical to the Youngstown Sports Grille' = p.ComparisonRef/p.Goal; to retains its goal-like function while introducing the standard of similarity. Comparative than ('better than I imagined,' 'higher than average prices') = p.ComparisonRef/p.ComparisonRef.

Temporal and frequency: 'after my fusions' and 'during the mornings' = p.Time/p.Time. 'on a weekly basis' is one multiword target = p.Frequency/p.Manner: the modifier gives recurrence rate, while the basis construction has Manner function.

Purpose and circumstance: 'recommend them for custom lighting/repair' = p.Purpose/p.Purpose, where the service is the intended use. 'frequent this restaurant ... for lunch' = p.Circumstance/p.Circumstance, identifying the meal occasion rather than a goal of recommendation.

Other reviewed patterns: passive 'owned/operated by the same people' = p.Agent/p.Agent. '@ Yards Brewery' = p.Locus/p.Locus. 'with higher than average prices' = p.Characteristic/p.Characteristic, as prices characterize the establishment. 'a problem with their hours' = p.Topic/p.Topic, as hours are the matter the problem concerns.

These rules summarize observed examples and relevant guidelines, not gold labels for unseen instances.
